items.title: US launches strikes on Iran after tankers hit in Strait of Hormuz
items.description: The US Central Command says the strikes are intended to impose "heavy costs" on Iran.

items.title: Marine Le Pen to run for French presidency and appeal conviction in top court
items.description: The hard-right National Rally leader has ended months of speculation, after a court ruled she could run but would have to wear a tag for a year.

items.title: Trump looms large as Nato grapples with challenge of rearming Europe
items.description: The US president's inflammatory words have punctuated the image of unity at this crucial gathering, Security Correspondent Frank Gardner writes.

items.title: Woman suspected of Monaco bomb attack found dead in Ukraine
items.description: Police had been hunting Anastasiia Berezovska after a Ukrainian millionaire was injured in the blast.

items.title: Lawyer says detained Gaza doctor was severely beaten in Israeli jail
items.description: The lawyer for Dr Hussam Abu Safiya tells the BBC his client was so badly beaten he could not recognise him during a visit last week.

items.title: New footage shown at Kirk hearing shows man on rooftop near shooting scene
items.description: The preliminary hearing will determine whether Tyler Robinson, accused of killing conservative activist Charlie Kirk, will stand trial.

items.title: Ghana halts visit by South African president amid row over anti-migrant protests
items.description: Many in Ghana feared his presence would lead to mass protests, and officials say it is postponed for now.

items.title: Hungary's public news broadcasts halted in bid to scrap Orban-era propaganda
items.description: The country's main state TV channel displayed a message saying it was "sorry" for lying on Tuesday.

items.title: Jailers and officials at Russia's 'torture prisons' in Ukraine exposed by BBC
items.description: Former prisoners accuse the men of abuse in detention centres and want to see them brought to trial.

items.title: Bomb explosions injure 18 in Damascus during Macron's visit
items.description: As reports of the blasts came in, state television said the Syrian president had welcomed Macron at the presidential palace.

items.title: China sentences official to death for taking $325m in bribes
items.description: The 69-year-old helped companies secure valuable contracts in exchange for money, a court heard.

items.title: Zimbabwean football star survives gun attack in South Africa
items.description: South African police say they are investigating a case of attempted murder but that no arrests have been made so far.
